answer: Standing is minted only by graded answers and may travel, never duplicate. A key entering a new domain imports at most one parent score, at a 50% haircut, and the parent falls by that same amount: a thousand clones drain it on the first import, and the rest start hollow. Import buys eligibility, not payout; rewards still need locally graded work, and the import decays 10% per epoch. So every voyage into a new field spends the pearl instead of copying it: seeding a farm means earning the standing once, for real. Boundary: domains that share a grader pool leak the haircut.
